If you're wondering if an executive membership at Costco is worth plopping down an extra $60 a year, we have the answer: Maybe. It all boils down to how much you spend. The $120.00 annual membership fee is exactly twice that of the standard $60 membership fee.

results.title: Costco raising membership fees for 1st time in 7 years
excerpts:
# Costco raising membership fees for 1st time in 7 years
FILE - People enter Costco Warehouse in Cranberry Township, Pa., Friday, March 29, 2024. Costco bargain hunters are going to have to pay an additional $5 to $10 annually as the popular warehouse chain prepares to raise its membership fees for the first time in seven years.

...

(CNN) - Sometimes you have to spend money to save money; at least that’s what Costco hopes its members think.
The retailer is raising membership fees.
It will cost basic members an extra $5 a year, bringing the cost up to $65.
Executive memberships are going up $10 to $130.
It’s the first membership price hike in seven years, but it should help keep other prices at the store down.
Last year, Costco made $4.6 billion from membership fees.
The new membership fees go into effect Sept. 1.

# Costco raises annual membership fees for the 1st time since 2017
## topics:
ISSAQUAH, Wash. — [Costco](https://komonews.com/topic/Costco) bargain hunters are going to have to pay an additional $5 to $10 annually as the popular warehouse chain prepares to raise its membership fees for the first time in seven years.

...

The new fees, set to take effect Sept. 1, will boost the price of Costco's basic Gold Star membership from $60 to $65 annually, while the cost for the premium Executive membership will rise from $120 to $130.
The annual fee had remained the same since 2017, despite several years of unusually high inflation rates that finally have been cooling down in recent months.

...

Besides the fee increase, Costco disclosed its sales for the five-week period ending July 7 rose by 7% from the same time last year to $24.48 billion.
